name: shipguard
description: AI-assisted code and logic audit, process simulation, visual E2E review, and agent mission guardrails.

interface.shortDescription: Audit code and logic, simulate behavior, review visuals, guard scope
interface.longDescription: ShipGuard bundles focused skills for static code audit, contract and invariant checking, diff-scoped process behavior simulation, browser-based visual checks, mission and authority guardrails, and unified review dashboards. It exposes what changed and how it was verified while leaving scope, fix, and ship decisions to the human.
defaultPrompt: Run ShipGuard on my current diff.
Audit this workflow or algorithm against its contracts and invariants.
Simulate the process behavior for this change.
Review visual regressions for impacted routes.
Lock this agent to my stated mission before working.
